001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.format;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;

006/**
007 * Builder to create {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
008 * The TTLL (Time, Thread, Level, Logger) text format, the default encoder, with each
009 * part configurable, see {@link TTLL}.
010 * <p>
011 * The defaults produce <code>12:00:00.123 [main] INFO  com.example.App - hello</code>
012 * followed by any stack trace. Parts set to none are left out along with their
013 * separating space. As properties of the encoder, each part is one of the lowercase
014 * names of its {@link TTLL} enum, for example
015 * <code>logging.appender.console.encoder.ttll.keyValues=json5</code>; keyValues
016 * accepts <code>json</code> and <code>json5</code> as well as <code>true</code>
017 * (percent encoding) and <code>false</code> (none). The timestamp property also
018 * accepts a DateTimeFormatter pattern in UTC. The color property decides whether to
019 * color and the theme property which colors; when neither is set the rainbowgum theme
020 * is used if the console supports ANSI.
021 * <table class="table">
022 * <caption><strong>Properties retrieved from LogProperties</strong></caption>
023 * <tr>
024 * <th>Property Pattern</th>
025 * <th>Type</th>
026 * <th>Required</th>
027 * <th>Default</th>
028 * <th>Description</th>
029 * </tr>
030 * <tr>
031 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ttll.timestamp" }</code></td>
032 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
033 * <td><code>true</code></td>
034 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.TimestampFormat#TTLL ttll}</td>
035 * <td>Time formatter, see {@link TTLL.TimestampFormat}.</td>
036 * </tr>
037 * <tr>
038 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ttll.thread" }</code></td>
039 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
040 * <td><code>true</code></td>
041 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ThreadFormat#NAME name}</td>
042 * <td>Thread formatter in square brackets, see {@link TTLL.ThreadFormat}.</td>
043 * </tr>
044 * <tr>
045 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ttll.level" }</code></td>
046 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
047 * <td><code>true</code></td>
048 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.LevelFormat#PADDED padded}</td>
049 * <td>Level formatter, see {@link TTLL.LevelFormat}.</td>
050 * </tr>
051 * <tr>
052 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ttll.logger" }</code></td>
053 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
054 * <td><code>true</code></td>
055 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.LoggerFormat#FULL full}</td>
056 * <td>Logger name formatter, see {@link TTLL.LoggerFormat}.</td>
057 * </tr>
058 * <tr>
059 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ttll.keyValues" }</code></td>
060 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
061 * <td><code>true</code></td>
062 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.KeyValuesFormat#PERCENT percent}</td>
063 * <td>Key values formatter in braces, see {@link TTLL.KeyValuesFormat}.</td>
064 * </tr>
065 * <tr>
066 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ttll.color" }</code></td>
067 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
068 * <td><code>false</code></td>
069 * <td><code>null</code></td>
070 * <td>Whether to color, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.</td>
071 * </tr>
072 * <tr>
073 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ttll.theme" }</code></td>
074 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
075 * <td><code>false</code></td>
076 * <td><code>null</code></td>
077 * <td>ANSI color theme, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.</td>
078 * </tr>
079 * <tr>
080 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ttll.keyValuesWhenEmpty" }</code></td>
081 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
082 * <td><code>false</code></td>
083 * <td><code>null</code></td>
084 * <td>Braces for no key values, see {@link TTLL.KeyValuesWhenEmpty}.</td>
085 * </tr>
086 * </table>
087 */
088public final class TTLLFormatterBuilder implements io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogBuilder<TTLLFormatterBuilder,io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter> {
089
090        /**
091         * The properties to be retrieved from config will have

094        static final String PROPERTY_PREFIX = "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ttll.";

097         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_timestamp } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter</code> Time formatter, see {@link TTLL.TimestampFormat}.
098         */
099        static final String PROPERTY_timestamp = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "timestamp";
100        /**
101         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_thread } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter</code> Thread formatter in square brackets, see {@link TTLL.ThreadFormat}.
102         */
103        static final String PROPERTY_thread = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "thread";
104        /**
105         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_level } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter</code> Level formatter, see {@link TTLL.LevelFormat}.
106         */
107        static final String PROPERTY_level = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "level";
108        /**
109         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_logger } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter</code> Logger name formatter, see {@link TTLL.LoggerFormat}.
110         */
111        static final String PROPERTY_logger = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "logger";
112        /**
113         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_keyValues } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter</code> Key values formatter in braces, see {@link TTLL.KeyValuesFormat}.
114         */
115        static final String PROPERTY_keyValues = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "keyValues";
116        /**
117         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_color } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorMode</code> Whether to color, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.
118         */
119        static final String PROPERTY_color = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "color";
120        /**
121         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_theme } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorTheme</code> ANSI color theme, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.
122         */
123        static final String PROPERTY_theme = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "theme";
124        /**
125         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_keyValuesWhenEmpty } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.KeyValuesWhenEmpty</code> Braces for no key values, see {@link TTLL.KeyValuesWhenEmpty}.
126         */
127        static final String PROPERTY_keyValuesWhenEmpty = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "keyValuesWhenEmpty";
128        
129        private final String propertyPrefix;
130        final String property_timestamp;
131        final String property_thread;
132        final String property_level;
133        final String property_logger;
134        final String property_keyValues;
135        final String property_color;
136        final String property_theme;
137        final String property_keyValuesWhenEmpty;

139        private final java.lang.String name;
140        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter timestamp = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLLFormatter.DEFAULT_TIMESTAMP;
141        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter thread = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLLFormatter.DEFAULT_THREAD;
142        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter level = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLLFormatter.DEFAULT_LEVEL;
143        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter logger = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLLFormatter.DEFAULT_LOGGER;
144        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter keyValues = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLLFormatter.DEFAULT_KEY_VALUES;
145        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorMode color = null;
146        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorTheme theme = null;
147        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable KeyValuesWhenEmpty keyValuesWhenEmpty = null;
148        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ServiceRegistry serviceRegistry;

150        /**
151         * Create a builder for {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
152         * @param name will fill <code>{name}</code> in <code>logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ttll.</code>. Encoder name, used for property lookup.
153         */
154        public TTLLFormatterBuilder(
155                        java.lang.String name
156                        ) {
157                try {
158                        java.util.Map<String,String> prefixParameters = java.util.Map.of(
159                                        "name", name
160                                );
161                        this.propertyPrefix = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_PREFIX, prefixParameters);
162                        this.name = name;
163                        property_timestamp = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_timestamp, prefixParameters);
164                        property_thread = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_thread, prefixParameters);
165                        property_level = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_level, prefixParameters);
166                        property_logger = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_logger, prefixParameters);
167                        property_keyValues = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_keyValues, prefixParameters);
168                        property_color = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_color, prefixParameters);
169                        property_theme = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_theme, prefixParameters);
170                        property_keyValuesWhenEmpty = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_keyValuesWhenEmpty, prefixParameters);
171                }
172                catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
173                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
174                }
175        }

298                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_logger, this.logger)
299                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_keyValues, this.keyValues)

311        @Override
312        public TTLLFormatterBuilder fromProperties(LogProperties properties) {
313                var __v = LogProperty.Validator.of(this.getClass());
314                var _timestamp = properties.forKey(property_timestamp).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLLFormatter.convertTimestamp(_v)).or(this.timestamp).validate(__v);
315                var _thread = properties.forKey(property_thread).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLLFormatter.convertThread(_v)).or(this.thread).validate(__v);
316                var _level = properties.forKey(property_level).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLLFormatter.convertLevel(_v)).or(this.level).validate(__v);
317                var _logger = properties.forKey(property_logger).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLLFormatter.convertLogger(_v)).or(this.logger).validate(__v);
318                var _keyValues = properties.forKey(property_keyValues).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLLFormatter.convertKeyValues(_v)).or(this.keyValues).validate(__v);
319                var _color = properties.forKey(property_color).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLLFormatter.convertColor(_v)).or(this.color).validateIfError(__v);
320                var _theme = properties.forKey(property_theme).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLLFormatter.convertTheme(_v)).or(this.theme).validateIfError(__v);
321                var _keyValuesWhenEmpty = properties.forKey(property_keyValuesWhenEmpty).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLLFormatter.convertKeyValuesWhenEmpty(_v)).or(this.keyValuesWhenEmpty).validateIfError(__v);
322                __v.validate();
323                this.timestamp = _timestamp.value();
324                this.thread = _thread.value();
325                this.level = _level.value();
326                this.logger = _logger.value();
327                this.keyValues = _keyValues.value();
328                this.color = _color.valueOrNull();
329                this.theme = _theme.valueOrNull();
330                this.keyValuesWhenEmpty = _keyValuesWhenEmpty.valueOrNull();
